text:
sam: FYI premerge for release/7.3 triggered the prompt/eval gate in the EU change window. summarizer suite flagged a small regression, deploybot blocked promotion. @maria @cheng can you weigh in?

deploybot: EVAL_GATE_BLOCK - promotion prevented for release/7.3 -> canary pinned. Suite: summarizer_v5_promptset, delta: quality -1.8% (relative), failing checks 4/180, threshold -1.0%. See /deploy/logs/1718409999.

maria: Can you paste the top-line numbers? is it user-visible elsewhere (search, autosummary)?

qa-bot: regression summary: n=1200 samples, rouge-ish delta -1.8%, hallucination rate +0.7ppt, fluency -0.9%. p95 latency +0.9ms. Confidence: 0.82. Threshold breach on "summarizer_fluency" (threshold -1.0%).

cheng: Quick take — the delta is just outside the gate. Not seeing downstream metric alerts yet but still worth being cautious. Options: 1) pin route to previous model (v7.2.9), 2) rollback full change, 3) accept and monitor with mitigations. My preference: pin + run targeted hotfix eval on the failing prompt subsets.

sam: +1 to pin. We can keep canary at 5% and enable auto-fallback if error/higher-latency spikes. I'll open a ticket and attach diffs.

maria: I can sign off on a pin if it's not user-visible and we add a brief note in release notes and monitoring playbook. Need ops ack for EU window.

ops-oncall: We're green on capacity. OK with a pin + staged traffic (5% canary) and fallback. Ops request: set anomaly hooks to slack #incidents and a PagerDuty escalation at 3x error baseline.

sam: Opening INF-3429 now with eval diffs and rollback plan. Command I used for the quick pin: 
```
deploybot pin-route --route summarizer-prod --model v7.2.9 --canary 5 --ticket INF-3429
```

deploybot: ACTION_APPLIED - route summarizer-prod pinned to model v7.2.9, canary=5%, fallback=enabled. Monitoring hooks: summ-telemetry, eval-diff-alerts.

maria: Adding a single sentence to release notes: "Preflight eval detected minor summarizer quality regression; route pinned to prior model and monitoring enabled. Infra will re-run hotfix eval."

sam: I'll run the focused eval set now (subset of the suite that hit failures) and post results in 30m.

(30m later)
sam: Focused eval complete: failure rate on failing prompts fell to baseline after small prompt-normalization tweak. Hotfix eval: delta now -0.2% and confidence 0.88. Logs: /artifacts/INF-3429/hotfix-1.

cheng: Nice. Proposal: leave pin for another hour, then attempt staged rollforward to v7.3 with a 2% canary and extended telemetry. If any alert, automatic fallback to v7.2.9.

maria: Agreed. I sign off on rollforward attempt provided we have the rollback guard.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. PagerDuty policy set. Ops monitoring running.

sam: Thanks all — leaving thread open for final rollforward in 45m. I will update INF-3429 and add the eval diffs to the release notes PR. :thumbsup:
